csu-aml-trametinib.identity: Exact CSU IACUC 7867; oral trametinib with prednisone.
csu-aml-trametinib.recruitment_sites: Pet's local oncologist; no travel to CSU
csu-aml-trametinib.eligibility: Confirmed canine AML with circulating cells; initial blood/urine tests and functional; no current other anti-cancer therapy, required prior chemotherapy washout, no severe comorbidity.
csu-aml-trametinib.funding: Study trametinib, prednisone, diagnostics for study monitoring and shipping

csu-tvt-single-radiation-2026.identity: Exact CSU IACUC 7968; single-fraction radiation plus two rechecks.
csu-tvt-single-radiation-2026.recruitment_sites: Veterinary Health System, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins CO
csu-tvt-single-radiation-2026.eligibility: Confirmed TVT with measurable/samplable lesion >1cm; fit for anesthesia; no prior surgery, radiation or systemic chemotherapy for target tumor; no advanced spread; immunosuppression washout 7 days.
csu-tvt-single-radiation-2026.funding: Protocol tests and radiation + rechecks covered; owner pays pre-enrollment exam and confirmation; $1000 credit if progression/persistent disease

penn-oral-scc-nir-margin-2026.identity: Penn VCIC definitive oral SCC surgery using IV cathepsin-activated near-infrared surgical margin imaging; assigns surgery, not an imaging-only referral.
penn-oral-scc-nir-margin-2026.recruitment_sites: Official named PennVet protocol; Philadelphia only.
penn-oral-scc-nir-margin-2026.eligibility: Dog with diagnosed oral SCC amenable to surgery; no current/prior treatment for target cancer; no immediate unrelated life-threatening condition; must attend Philadelphia visits.
penn-oral-scc-nir-margin-2026.funding: Penn contributes $3000 toward surgery; other costs not specified.
penn-oral-scc-nir-margin-2026.deadline: October 21, 2026 is page posting, not enrollment cutoff; no cutoff listed.

auburn-palbociclib-solid-cancers.identity: Exact Auburn oral palbociclib dose pilot and current named histiocytic sarcoma inclusion; older AVMA title is not an exclusion override.
auburn-palbociclib-solid-cancers.recruitment_sites: Current named Auburn Oncology Service enrollment at Auburn AL; no extra branch published.
auburn-palbociclib-solid-cancers.eligibility: Dog with measurable and progressing mammary carcinoma, melanoma, SCC, histiocytic sarcoma or AGASACA; prior treatment allowed, otherwise healthy.
auburn-palbociclib-solid-cancers.funding: Initial exam/screening owner paid; up to two months of trial drug/biopsy, rechecks and labs covered.
auburn-palbociclib-solid-cancers.deadline: No cutoff published; two months is subsidized treatment period.
